description: Enhanced producer-enrichment coverage: the producer hook runs once per producer span so a two-message publish stamps each span with its own message-derived attribute; and when a version attribute is also configured both extra attributes appear together in sorted order on each span.

cases.expected_output:
produce topic=topic-name-1 status=ok result_records=0
inject msg=0 carries=span#0
inject msg=1 carries=span#1
spans=2
span 0 kind=producer name=topic-name-1 trace=t0 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=topic-name-1
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
  attribute-from-hook=first payload
span 1 kind=producer name=topic-name-1 trace=t1 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=topic-name-1
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
  attribute-from-hook=second payload

produce topic=topic-name-1 status=ok result_records=0
inject msg=0 carries=span#0
spans=1
span 0 kind=producer name=topic-name-1 trace=t0 parent=root status=unset
  messaging.system=kafka
  messaging.destination=topic-name-1
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
  attribute-from-hook=payload with version
  module.version=<version>
